_doc: Numeric lookup registry for the consolidated SAR toolchain. Look up by number: python3 sar/registry.py <id> [--test]. IDs are stable; never reuse a retired number.

100.name: blue-ocean-sar
100.what: Sensing toolchain: person finder, dual comms publisher, provenance, evidence package, opendata adapters, realdata terrain/NDVI/change/sweep-width modules

120.name: blue-ocean-sar/opendata
120.what: Public open-data adapters (fixtures only in tests)

130.name: blue-ocean-sar/realdata
130.what: DEM terrain, microtopography, Sentinel-2 NDVI/change, sweep width, field log, evidence scoring/fusion

140.name: blue-ocean-sar/public_records_engine
140.what: Pluggable public-records engine (no built-in data; Census Geocoder connector; authority required per connector)

150.name: blue-ocean-sar/master_sensor_wave_search
150.what: Multi-band GPR/sensor scoring script (covered by test_provenance.py, 22 tests)

200.name: hfmr
200.what: Historical forensic material reanalysis: acquisition, archive, retrieval, discovery, municipal/construction records, evidence engine

400.name: sensor-fusion-grid
400.what: Sensor fusion into a voxel grid

510.name: ert-model
510.what: Analytic/semi-analytic DC resistivity forward model (Wenner/dipole-dipole; layered half-space; buried sphere/void)

520.name: magnetometry-model
520.what: Analytic total-field magnetometry forward model (buried dipole/sphere, thin dyke) with seeded noise

530.name: gpr-void-detector
530.what: Deterministic GPR void detector (hyperbola fit + polarity/contrast) on synthetic B-scans; no Ultralytics
530.source: deepscan specs v0 — synthetic only; gprMax offline-only if used to build fixtures

700.name: coldtrace
700.what: Temporal GIS FastAPI backend (viewshed, NDVI/elevation change, heat map). No demo data: missing inputs answer {status: no_data} HTTP 424

800.name: lpb
800.what: Data-driven lost-person-behavior distance rings; tables must cite a source (unverified tables refused by default)

810.name: instrument_input
810.what: LiDAR (LAS/CSV) and GPR (CSV) file input plus deterministic synthetic samples in local metres (no geo coords)
810.source: replaces layer-peel src/components/sensor-mock.tsx as the data source

820.name: exif_metadata
820.what: EXIF metadata reader (camera, datetime, GPS, software)

850.name: decode_hooks
850.what: Decode seam: one conditioning point for decoded sensor data. Hooks registered here run inside read_cog_window (910) and read_points/read_gpr_csv (810). Identity until a hook is registered.
850.source: Audrey Evans design decision 2026-10-22/23: inject at the encoding/decoding layer rather than higher up the stack

900.name: geo_connectors
900.what: Live public geo connectors with retry/backoff and host allowlist; recorded fixtures for offline tests; SAR_LIVE_TESTS=1 for live
900.source: Gemini Notebook SAR bootstrap (master_unified_sar_bootstrap.py), rewritten to call the real endpoints

901.name: geo_connectors/netio
901.what: HTTP: https-only allowlist, 429/5xx/network retry with exponential backoff + jitter, size cap

910.name: geo_connectors/stac
910.what: STAC search (Element84 Earth Search S1/S2, NASA CMR LPCLOUD HLS) with paging; COG window read; NDVI, ΔNDVI, S1 log-ratio dB, sigma anomalies

920.name: geo_connectors/dep3
920.what: USGS 3DEP DTM exportImage (GeoTIFF), getSamples point elevations, DTM difference

930.name: geo_connectors/wayback
930.what: Wayback CDX query and content-digest change list

940.name: geo_connectors/arcgis
940.what: ArcGIS REST layer query, GeoJSON, resultOffset paging; municipal hosts via allow_host()

950.name: geo_connectors/mcp_server
950.what: stdio MCP server: search_stac_satellite, query_usgs_lidar, sample_usgs_elevation, wayback_cdx_diff, arcgis_query

960.name: geo_connectors/verify_connectors
960.what: Live health check of all 5 endpoints; writes out/health.json and status=PASS|FAIL to $GITHUB_OUTPUT (used by aegis-health-check)

970.name: geo_connectors/run_sectors
970.what: Sector pipeline from a case config: cloud-filtered STAC, COG ΔNDVI, 3DEP centre elevation (used by aegis-sar-runner)

980.name: geo_connectors/hyp3
980.what: ASF HyP3 Sentinel-1 InSAR: same-track/same-frame pair selection from the ASF search API, plus job submission via hyp3_sdk (free tier, Earthdata login from env or ~/.netrc, never argv)

990.name: forensic_pipeline
990.what: Synthetic search-scenario pipeline: pure-function residuals for snow wells, rootball trenches, culvert ice trajectory, pipe airflow/odour, local image accent, synthetic priors, confirmation events. Array-in/array-out, no I/O.
990.note: PYTEST, not unittest, and that is deliberate: forensic_pipeline/tests/test_snow_wells_pipes.py is written pytest-style (bare test_* functions, plain assert, pytest.approx). `unittest discover` collects only TestCase subclasses, so registering this directory under a unittest component would collect ZERO tests and report success -- coverage that reads green and runs nothing.
990.requires: pytest, numpy, scipy (all three already installed by sar/Dockerfile.tests)
990.source: Committed 2026-10-27/28 but covered by no component, so it had never executed. Registered 2026-11-04 after the governance audit found it; see sar/docs/WORK_RANKING_2026-11-04.md.

995.name: registry_coverage
995.what: Guard on this file: asserts every test_*.py in the repository is reachable by some component's test command, so a test file can never again be committed outside every scope and counted as coverage. Fails on a test-command shape it cannot interpret rather than ignoring it.
995.source: Regression test for the 2026-11-04 fix that registered component 990, per standards/GREEN_MAIN_STANDARD.md (a regression test with every fix).

1000.name: language_scan
1000.what: Repository-wide guard on VISITING_AGENTS.md section 1: asserts no live line in any .py file carries the vocabulary revvel-standards/.github/workflows/anti-scaffolding-enforcer.yml flags (the two deferral markers, the two framing words, the five phrases), with the enforcer's own case sensitivity and per-word exemptions. The vocabulary and the matching live in language_scan.py, shared with the narrower multi_proxy scan, so there is one implementation and not two copies. Skips exactly two machine-delimited regions -- a REVVEL-DISABLED block and a section 2.2 header box, both of which the standards require to quote what they replaced -- and fails on an unbalanced delimiter rather than silently scanning less. Two exemptions beyond the enforcer's, each a rule about shape with its reason stated in the module and tested from both sides: a match inside a longer Python identifier, and a quoted low-entropy fake-secret prefix. No file-level exemption list, and none for itself: the words are assembled from fragments so the guard does not match its own source.
1000.source: Audit item 4. Nothing in this repository enforced the standard; the enforcer workflow lives in revvel-standards and never ran here, which is how four flagged lines sat in multi_proxy from 2026-10-24. PR #8 scanned multi_proxy only and said why: widening it then would have made main red for defects it was added to report, which GREEN_MAIN_STANDARD.md forbids. The 16 lines outstanding outside multi_proxy are resolved as of 2026-11-04 -- 11 by the two shape rules, 5 by comment-only fixes -- so the scan now covers the repository. See sar/docs/WORK_RANKING_2026-11-04.md.

deselected_tests.evidence.test_importers.Columbus: Needs realdata/columbus_records.py, which is left out (case-specific records).

llm: No component calls an LLM. Any future LLM step must be optional, gated by SAR_LLM_ENABLE=1, and use a small local model through SAR_LLM_BASE_URL (OpenAI-compatible, e.g. Ollama http://localhost:11434/v1).
